page.overview:
Who is Fancy Pants' entourage?

Swan Song, Golden Gavel, and Silver Frames are three ponies who first appear in Sweet and Elite. They are unnamed in the show, but they are named in merchandise, and Swan Song is also named in another depiction.

Swan Song resembles "Rain Dance" in color scheme, resembles Orange Swirl, "Candy Mane", and "Sweet Tart" in coat and mane colors, and resembles S02E11 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #2 in mane and eye colors. Her hat design is included in Rarity's Bridal Boutique.

Golden Gavel resembles S04E08 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #1 in color scheme and clothing, resembles "Chocolate Sun", "Dirtbound", and S01E26 Unnamed Earth Stallion #2 in color scheme, and resembles Crafty Crate, "Kazooie", Tight Ship, Dr. Hooves, "Concerto", Globe Trotter, Sheriff Silverstar, and Jack Hammer in coat and eye colors.

Silver Frames resembles "Star Bright", "Uncle Wing", and "Indigo (new poll)" in color scheme, resembles "Sightseer", "Tornado Bolt", Steam Roller, and "Written Script" in coat and mane colors, and resembles "Star Gazer" in coat and eye colors. Her hat design is included in Rarity's Bridal Boutique.
